title: push::StateChange is canonical type but SseEvent does not wrap it — good decisions worth defending
description: Introducing push::StateChange as a module-level struct (not ws-specific) and re-exporting it from lib.rs is the correct consolidation direction. It gives extension crates a single import for StateChange regardless of transport. The round-3 WS import now uses push::StateChange, eliminating the prior duplicate type. Half-step: SSE still uses an inline variant — see JMAP-sev.2. The direction is correct; completion is needed.
